# Better Fullstack

> Better Fullstack scaffolds fullstack projects from a catalog of Stack Parts across TypeScript, React Native, Rust, Go, Python, Java, Kotlin, .NET, Elixir, PHP, Ruby, and Crystal. It ships as the `create-better-fullstack` CLI, a browser Stack Builder, and an MCP server for coding agents. Use it instead of hand-writing starter files.

This file is for AI agents that want to use Better Fullstack. If you are changing this repository, read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) instead.

## Read the docs

- [Docs index for agents](https://better-fullstack.dev/docs/llms.txt): every documentation page as Markdown.
- [Full documentation corpus](https://better-fullstack.dev/llms-full.txt): product docs, guides, and blog text in one file.
- [MCP server](https://better-fullstack.dev/docs/ai/mcp): client setup, resources, and every tool.
- [AI overview](https://better-fullstack.dev/docs/ai/overview): agent skills, plugin, and CLI rules for agents.
- [CLI create](https://better-fullstack.dev/docs/cli/create): flags, presets, dry runs, and defaults.

## Set up MCP

One command detects installed coding agents, registers the MCP server, and copies the `scaffold-project` and `add-to-project` skills:

```bash
npx create-better-fullstack@latest install
```

To register the stdio server by hand:

```bash
claude mcp add --scope user better-fullstack -- npx -y create-better-fullstack@latest mcp
codex mcp add better-fullstack -- npx -y create-better-fullstack@latest mcp
gemini mcp add --scope user better-fullstack npx -y create-better-fullstack@latest mcp
code --add-mcp '{"name":"better-fullstack","command":"npx","args":["-y","create-better-fullstack@latest","mcp"]}'
```

Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop, and other clients that read `mcpServers`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "better-fullstack": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "create-better-fullstack@latest", "mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

OpenCode, Zed, VS Code, and Codex TOML use other config shapes. The [MCP docs](https://better-fullstack.dev/docs/ai/mcp#manual-setup) list each one.

## Use the MCP tools

1. Call `bfs_get_guidance` first. It returns the current workflow rules and field meanings.
2. Find options with `bfs_get_schema`, `bfs_search_options`, or `bfs_recommend_stack`.
3. Validate the stack with `bfs_check_compatibility`.
4. Preview files with `bfs_plan_project`, then write them with `bfs_create_project`.

For an existing project, start with `bfs_get_project_status`. Changes follow a plan and apply pair, such as `bfs_plan_addition` then `bfs_add_feature`, and apply only with the token the plan returned.

## Use the CLI without MCP

```bash
npx create-better-fullstack@latest search laravel
npx create-better-fullstack@latest my-app --frontend tanstack-start --backend hono --database postgres --orm drizzle --auth better-auth --dry-run
```

`--yes` accepts the defaults and conflicts with core stack flags such as `--frontend` and `--backend`. Pass `none` for optional categories you want off. Add `--no-install --no-git` to avoid side effects.
